data.turoyo: W iḏa d mapəč hən w bəṯr d omalle l ḥa: “Kalá aʕmux, háwliyo!”, — iḏa tuyo aʕme, gšəqli i ʕisaqṯo mu ġurub ḥreno, bəṯr hənnək gmakərxila.
data.translation: Und wenn er ein Paar Mann für leer erklärt hat und dann zu einem sagt: "Du hast ihn, gib ihn her!", und der betreffende hat ihn wirklich, so nehmen sie den Ring der anderen Partei ab, und nun lassen sie ihn herumgehen.

rationale: First new example of technicalIII2: singular subject and overt partitive player object, followed by identifying the actual holder.

summary: All three occurrences reviewed. I1 remains intransitive becoming empty/deflating;III1 remains caused emptying, illustrated by letting air out of a ball.

NewIII2 is technical/declarative: a player is judged not to hold the ring. The object changes from a container emptied to a person classified, and the game proceeds by identifying the actual holder. This is a meaning difference, not merely a participant extension.
94/471 supplies unprefixed dependent Infectum with hən;94/473 uses ko-Infectum and reciprocal ḥḏoḏe with active morphology. Reciprocity does not create a Detransitive.

The two technical tokens belong to one account, not two independent texts. The inherited94/473 quotation is reassigned without rewriting its German or adding a duplicate.52/73 is also already inherited.
